# openwrt_sys_process_list (Data Source)

Retrieves the list of running processes from OpenWrt.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID.
- `processes` (List of Object) List of running processes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--processes))

<a id="nestedatt--processes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `processes`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String)
- `pgid` (Number)
- `pid` (Number)
- `ppid` (Number)
- `state` (String)
- `urandom` (String)
- `user` (String)
